title: Breakdown Assistant
description: A mobile application designed to provide assistance to drivers in the event of a vehicle breakdown. The app offers features such as real-time location tracking, emergency contact notifications, and a directory of nearby repair shops and towing services.

features: Directory of Nearby Repair Shops and Towing Services

highlights.title: Real-time Location Tracking
highlights.description: The app utilizes GPS technology to provide real-time location tracking, allowing users to share their location with emergency contacts and service providers for quick assistance.

highlights.title: Emergency Contact Notifications
highlights.description: In the event of a breakdown, the app automatically sends notifications to pre-selected emergency contacts, providing them with the user's location and details of the situation.

highlights.title: Directory of Nearby Repair Shops and Towing Services
highlights.description: The app includes a comprehensive directory of nearby repair shops and towing services, allowing users to quickly find and contact assistance in their area.
